01 / CONTRIBUTION

Product design & Flutter engineering

Designed and developed Etzan: the Flutter interface, feature journeys, shared design system, Arabic/English layouts and Supabase client integrations.

  • Designed and implemented onboarding, account creation and guest exploration.
  • Built coach discovery, profiles and booking/session interfaces alongside goals, habits and daily planning.
  • Implemented journaling, mood selection, progress dashboards and account interfaces.
  • Organized shared UI and feature code, with layered Auth, Dashboard and Notifications implementations, Cubit state and GetIt dependency injection.
  • Integrated Supabase Auth, database, Storage and realtime access in the mobile codebase.
Scope & status

An independent personal-growth and life-coaching portfolio project, not a clinical treatment product or an app-store release. The Android APK is a portfolio preview, built in release mode but signed with a debug certificate. Service-backed journeys need an available, configured backend; payment-provider integration is not implemented. Screenshots show the interface at capture time, not guaranteed live data or business results.

Inside the experience

02 / PRODUCT FLOWS
01

Find your starting point

Explore as a guest, discover coaches by name or specialty, and browse coach profiles. Booking, sessions and chat interfaces depend on configured services.

02

Turn intention into a routine

Create goals and milestones, track habits and organize a daily plan with calendar views.

03

Reflect and keep perspective

Journal, select a mood and review personal progress alongside profile and achievement views.

03 / ENGINEERING

Behind the interface.

Arabic-first, shared foundations

A shared design system supports Arabic/English localization, RTL/LTR layouts, adaptive navigation and light/dark settings.

Feature and data boundaries

Features share core UI and infrastructure. Auth, Dashboard and Notifications use presentation/domain/data layers, repositories, use cases, Cubit and dependency injection; other journeys use a shared backend repository.

Service-aware delivery

The mobile implementation connects to Supabase. Account flows require configured tables, RPCs, storage buckets and access policies; the repository includes supporting SQL and backend notes, rather than a complete database bootstrap. Mapper, widget and smoke-test sources are available for review.
